parts.watchFor: The signs come before the Hour, not on it. Watch what happens to the light in the town.

questions.q: Which signs did the Prophet ﷺ say would come before the Hour?
options: A great flood, and the end of the sea
Religious knowledge taken away, earthquakes increasing, and time passing quickly
The sun rising in the west, and the mountains moving
A new prophet, and a new scripture

questions.q: What happens to the lamps of the town?
options: They are blown out one by one
They burn brighter and brighter
They go out from one end to the other, until barely any light is left
They are carried away by the wind

questions.q: What did the Prophet ﷺ say people would compete to build?
options: Deep wells
Long roads
High buildings
Large fleets

lesson.text: Before the Hour comes, the signs appear one by one. The Prophet ﷺ named them: religious knowledge taken away, earthquakes increasing, time passing quickly, wealth so abundant that no one needs charity, and people competing to build ever higher.
lesson.curious: These signs are told in a hadith of al-Bukhari (7121) and Sahih Muslim (2935), not in the Quran. Muslims read them as warnings about what a society drifts toward when it stops caring about what it knows.

reflect.muslim: What knowledge of your faith has got harder to find than it used to be? What could you do about that this week?
reflect.curious: What have you learned that people around you have not? What would it mean to share it?

parts.act: Teach one thing you know about God to someone who does not know it.

parts.watchFor: These signs come at the Hour itself. Watch the sun, and watch which way it rises.

questions.q: What does the Quran say happens to the sun?
options: It is wrapped up in darkness
It stands still in the sky
It falls into the sea
It splits in two

questions.q: Which direction is the sun said to rise from, in the hadith of the eleven signs?
options: The East
The North
The West
Straight above the Kaaba

questions.q: What does the Quran say will happen to a soul on the Day some of the signs come?
options: It will find nothing to answer for
It will be told what it brought with it
It will be returned to the world
It will be given another chance

lesson.text: The signs at the Hour are the ones the Quran itself paints: the sun wrapped up in darkness, the stars falling dispersing, the mountains removed, and the sun rising from the West. When the signs come, the choice has already been made.
lesson.curious: The sun rising from the West comes from a hadith, not from the Quran. The Quran asks the question it answers: what are you waiting for? And it answers: we too are waiting.

carry.title: The prayer of the one who is waiting

reflect.muslim: If the sign could come tonight, what would you want to have already changed?
reflect.curious: If everything you did were weighed tomorrow, what would you hope it added up to?

parts.act: Make one small correction this week that you would want counted.
